title: Northgate Card Credit Line Review — Addition for Line Use
content:
In the review of a requested credit line increase on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the usage line addition follows the account's use of its line at the review, the use being the amount owed divided by the current credit limit:

- where the use is at least 70 percent (0.7), it is 5 percent of the highest new balance shown on any statement of the account, rounded half up to the cent;
- where the use is below 10 percent (0.1), it is 5 percent of the payments credited on the account over the last 12 months less the payments returned unpaid in that time, that difference never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent;
- in every other case there is none.

A total over the last 12 months takes the entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the review date. The amount owed is the account's current balance; a credit balance is an amount owed below zero, and its use is below 10 percent.

| Use of the line at the review | Usage line addition |
|---|---|
| 70 percent or more | 5 percent of the highest statement new balance |
| at least 10 percent and below 70 percent | none |
| below 10 percent | 5 percent of the payments credited in the last 12 months less those returned unpaid, never less than zero |

## Hypothetical cases

- Credit limit 3000.00, amount owed 2100.00: use 70 percent, at the boundary, so the high-use method applies; the highest statement new balance on the account was 2384.10, and 5 percent of it is 119.205, taken as 119.21.
- Credit limit 3000.00, amount owed 2099.99: use just below 70 percent and above 10 percent, so there is none.
- Credit limit 3000.00, amount owed 150.00: use 5 percent; payments credited in the last 12 months 1840.00, of which 120.00 were returned unpaid, leave 1720.00, and 5 percent is 86.00.
